characters.afterPurchase: Filled the crate. Then my sister brought another empty crate. She knows me too well.
characters.subsequentErrand: Have you any glass bottles people have finished with?

characters.appearance: woman age 36, warm brown skin, wide nose, dark coiled hair tied high, calm direct expression
characters.name: Livia Stillwell
characters.intro: I'll buy fabric. My customer wants to mend her own coat. Hard to sell her a whole roll in good conscience.
characters.afterPurchase: She came back wearing it. Couldn't see the mend until she showed me.
characters.subsequentErrand: Any cloth for small jobs?

characters.appearance: man age 52, tan skin, broad face, receding gray hair, trimmed mustache, tired gentle eyes
characters.name: Yusuf Ashford
characters.intro: Got shampoo? I've a row of households on my books and three teenagers in one of them.
characters.afterPurchase: Three bottles in a week. Turns out they wash the dog as well.
characters.subsequentErrand: Shampoo for my delivery bag.

characters.appearance: woman age 44, olive skin, angular nose, black bob with one silver streak, reserved expression
characters.name: Amina Morrow
characters.intro: Some wire for my cloth stand. When the wind gets up my best fabric goes up the street like a sail.
characters.afterPurchase: It held in the wind. First calm day a customer walked off with the hanger still in her coat.
characters.subsequentErrand: Wire for the stall frame, if you've got some.

characters.appearance: man age 29, dark skin, narrow jaw, cropped curls, slight crooked smile
characters.name: Nico Venn
characters.intro: A torch. I need to see under a counter I just fitted. There's a screw left over and I can't say I'm pleased about it.
characters.afterPurchase: Screw belonged to my torch clip. Counter was sound the whole time.
characters.subsequentErrand: Got a light I can take on a fitting job?

characters.appearance: woman age 61, pale skin, lined face, short white hair and rectangular spectacles
characters.name: Dagmar Tallis
characters.intro: Could I buy a ready-made meal? I'm supposed to tell a cook what people eat on break. I usually skip mine.
characters.afterPurchase: I sat on the same step as his customers. Biggest complaint was that you need a free hand for the lid.
characters.subsequentErrand: Anything I can eat on my break?

characters.appearance: woman age 32, dark brown skin, oval face, side braid and small scar at eyebrow
characters.name: Elin Fenwick
characters.intro: I need electronics for a salvage lot. There's a kid at my stall who can fix absolutely anything with a switch.
characters.afterPurchase: Gave it back working. Said my switch was upside down. Paid her anyway.
characters.subsequentErrand: Any electronic bits for the repair lot?

characters.appearance: man age 67, pale weathered skin, broad nose, bald crown and gray side hair, deep smile lines
characters.name: Harris Brass
characters.intro: The night market sign went out on the word NIGHT. I'd like a battery before people show up at breakfast.
characters.afterPurchase: We lit the whole sign. Breakfast crowd still came. Had to get a cook in.
characters.subsequentErrand: Power cell for the market sign.

characters.appearance: woman age 48, tawny skin, stocky build, dark auburn crop, practical serious expression
characters.name: Mirabel Corven
characters.intro: I'm buying fillets for a trial run. The cannery boss wants to know what fish tastes like before we put it in tins.
characters.afterPurchase: We served it straight off the pan. Might've made the tinning part harder to sell.
characters.subsequentErrand: Fish fillets, please. I'll take them straight to the kitchen.

characters.appearance: man age 41, olive skin, hooked nose, wavy black hair, light stubble, relaxed shoulders
characters.name: Stefan Lowell
characters.intro: Need noodles. One pantry on my round keeps ordering less than a case. I'm breaking the case myself this week.
characters.afterPurchase: Turned out to be one old fellow feeding everybody on his landing. He knows how many mouths better than I do.
characters.subsequentErrand: Noodles for the pantry round.

characters.appearance: woman age 27, freckled light skin, red hair in loose bun, wide-set modest-sized eyes
characters.name: Yvette Hale
characters.intro: I'm buying snacks for a counter display. Got a spot at kid height and a spot at granddad height.
characters.afterPurchase: Granddads went for the bottom shelf. Kids asked what was on top. Moved the shelves.
characters.subsequentErrand: What's small enough to sell by the till?

characters.appearance: woman age 55, dark skin, silver twists, round strong face, skeptical eyebrow
characters.name: Ramona Darrow
characters.intro: Hand tools. A customer brought me a photo of the screw she needs out. Her thumb's covering the screw.
characters.afterPurchase: She came back with the whole drawer. It was a nail.
characters.subsequentErrand: I'll take a look at the tools for my repair stall.

characters.appearance: man age 35, brown skin, tall forehead, short dark curls, compact beard, watchful eyes
characters.name: Perrin Evers
characters.intro: Beans, please. I'm doing the market books tonight. Somebody's put a sausage down as office equipment.
characters.afterPurchase: Found their note. They'd paid the lad who moved the desk in sausages. Books balance now.
characters.subsequentErrand: Coffee for the end-of-week count.
